question: Down 14 in the 4th, should a team go for two after the first touchdown?
answer: Yes. With two TDs and a stop, going for 2 first wins 59% vs 47% kicking. Teams went for 2 54% of the time in 2025-26.
findings: Win chance gain given two TDs: +12.1 pts (+9.7 to +14.4).
Down 8 at a Q4 PAT: went for 2 in 2 of 72 in 2015-18, 13 of 24 in 2025-26.
The early 2-pt result also tells the team whether it needs a TD or a TD and 2 on the next drive.
method: Closed-form win chance given two TDs and no opponent score, with pooled 2-pt and XP rates; CI from Beta draws of both rates. Go-for-2 share counts Q4 tries at down 8, Wilson CIs.
data: nflverse play-by-play, 2015 to 2026 wk 8; 193 Q4 PATs at down 8; 1,458 2-pt tries.
split_check: Gain holds with 2015-20 rates (+11.7 pts) and 2021-26 rates (+12.3 pts).

chart.title: Share going for 2 when down 8 at a 4th-quarter PAT
